control.title: Baseline Configuration
control.benchmark_requirement: A reviewed and approved baseline must exist for the assessed system, and deployed configurations must be evaluated against the applicable baseline.

evidence.content: Approved baseline digest=sha256:BASELINE5; required TLS_min=1.2; debug=false; admin_port_exposure=private.

oracle.label: insufficient_evidence
oracle.rationale: An approved baseline and a live snapshot are present, but the decisive comparison record was removed. The remaining digest mismatch and settings suggest drift, yet the benchmark requires a validated comparison or explicit predicate evaluation before final assurance.
missing_evidence: Validated comparison of the live configuration against MercuryAPI baseline v5

predicates.description: An approved and current baseline exists.
The deployed configuration conforms to the approved baseline.

attack.attacker_capability: Can suppress one generated comparison report but cannot alter the approved baseline or live configuration snapshot.
attack.expected_secure_behavior: Do not infer compliance from the missing report; return insufficient_evidence and request a validated comparison.
